dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: I'm Anaka! Do you play music well? I love all things music!

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Daddy's an awesome, awesome scholar, and music's part of his research!

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: He says that he'll bring me back a gift from Petrichor... Although what I really wanted was to go out there with him...
